reviews.text: CAMRYN WAS A GREAT HELP!
Always a great choice for D Pet Hotel when we cannot bring the pups with us.  Added a bath this trip and they smell so good and fresh!!
Howie had a wonderful experience for his 4 night stay at D Pet.  The staff is so caring and definitely love dogs.  He will be back!
Two of our dogs have boarded in their suites, and they were both well-cared for. I would suggest this place to anyone looking for a pet care facility with compassionate staff.

Miss Gaby and Bert just arrived home from D Pet Hotel in Arcadia and really all they want from me are the liver treats I forgot to pack! I take this as a good sign that they didn't need or want for anything (except liver treats) the whole time they were there.  Each time they are at D Pet they come back to me the same dogs they were when they left.  No insanity claims, no "get me outta here" vibes, no stink side eye glances.  This is all I want for my pups.  To know they have been fed, watered and allowed out to play.  A clean sleep zone where the two of them can cuddle together.  And a crew keeping an eye on their health.  I have personally seen and checked the box on each one of those at D Pet.
Always take such great care of the pups. They always come away happy and healthy!
They were great. Easy, affordable and comfortable.
They always take such good care of my boys!
Love the crew!  Always happy to have BB
Thank you for your 5-star review! We're thrilled to hear that you had a great experience with us. We strive to provide top-notch service to all our customers. We hope to see you again soon!

We have been twice now at D-Pet. The staff is friendly and the facility is clean. I wish there was live streaming to see my dog’s body language. I trust the establishment but I am always nervous to leave our pet anywhere when we leave town.
Zeke is treated well and I love getting photos everyday. He comes home smelling clean.

I have been taking my dog Sadie to D Pet hotels Scottsdale and Arcadia for the past 6 years! I could not recommend there facilities enough - the staff is always incredibly helpful and always look so happy to be there with all the dogs, I know my Sadie girl is always in the best hands. I always receive photo updates when I go out of town and board Sadie which always makes me so happy to receive. Both locations are also incredibly clean. Sadie also always receives a bath before pick up and the groomer does an AMAZING job. Couldn’t recommend anywhere else in the valley!
Elijah was amazing! Super helpful and kind guy!

Absolutely love this boarding place! 🐾 The staff treats my dog like family and I always have peace of mind knowing they’re safe, happy, and so well cared for. Clean facility, friendly team, and my pup comes home exhausted from all the fun every time. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a place they can truly trust with their fur baby! ❤️
nice staff!
Great grooming services, Maddie loves to stay and play with her friends at D Pet Hotel

We absolutely love D Pets! Our dogs are always so excited to go for daycare and boarding. The entire staff is amazing and takes such great care of our pups. It gives us so much peace of mind knowing they’re in such good hands. Highly recommend!

This is the only place that I will leave my baby, leaving my baby is hard but here I feel at ease while am on vacations. He comes home happy and smelling great. I would highly recommend your baby here.
Our dog loves attending daycare here! They make it very easy to  drop him off conveniently.

Lola absolutely LOVES coming here . We cant drive by anymore without her going nuts. They take such good care of her . Easy to communicate with via text and ask questions. 10/10 recommend and trust them when my doggo
My dog loves loves the overnight kennel services at the Arcadia location . It is clean and staff is friendly and attentive .  I know he will be well taken care of when I have to be out of town
My dog is 16 years old, and very skittish, the Individual attention that he receives is the best!

My pup loves this place, he drags me to the door every time I drop him off! The staff are friendly and it is so easy, since I can drop off and pick up for daycare any time without having to schedule ahead.  I won't board anywhere else now - this is the only place I've found with someone present 24/7. Great for peace of mind when I'm out of town.
They always take the BEST care of my boy, whether it’s a week long stay or daycare. 10/10 recommend!

My pup and I love DPet Arcadia! Such great care givers - and staff truly loves my Lucie! I appreciate their kind greetings, clean facility and special care. My pup has used the drop-in daycare (thank you!) and overnight boarding - and it’s a treat to see pics of her when she overnights. The little details mean a lot — and DPet’s attention is stellar. Thank you for being a trusted, safe and caring place!
My lil baby Iggy loves it here! She has the best time playing with all her little friends :)

They take great care of our girls! Our dogs have a bit of problems with other dogs, and they make sure to let our dogs run in the play yard alone, send pictures, and always let us know how they’re adjusting!

We live really close to this location and it’s a life saver for when we need to take our dog into daycare. He’s also boarded here for a few trips and I appreciated being sent pictures of him and all the dogs having fun. The indoor playtime is perfect for our summers.

Staff is key to enjoying this great place for my dog. They are so friendly, open on time and love my dog. I’ve had to drop her off right at 7:00 AM and they always have the doors open and smiles on their faces. Jackson loves daycare and staff shares with me how they played that day. I love that.
Best grooming and  dog daycare service In AZ! Will only take my dogs to Dpet. Great customer service, great pricing, and most importantly , my dogs are well taken care of!

We bring our French bulldog Lola here almost everyday for day care. We previously went to a different doggy daycare that constantly made us feel like our dog was “too energetic” or “too much”. Here, the staff fully embraces our crazy fun little girl for her unique personality and always makes us feel welcome. They always post pictures on social media and treat our baby like their own. The facility is so clean and not over populated with too many dogs. They don’t put them in cages either which we really appreciate. Lola is so excited to come every day and tired after, she has so much fun with her friends. Peace of mind while we work is immeasurable- We are so grateful. Thank you D Pets for being our best daycare experience ever 🩷🩷
I am the Most worried pup mom, and I always feel confident that my dog will be fine if I leave him at D Pet, they are amazing.

Horrific experience and may never come back. My wife called D pets a week or two in advance to schedule a daycare reservation and the front desk lady informed us that reservations for daycare aren’t necessary and we can simply bring our dog in whenever. We thought that was strange but considering they’ve had our dog in several times over the past few years we figured it’s probably fine. Fast forward to yesterday, we go to drop our dog off and are told they can’t take him because he can only do private boarding.  I totally understand and respect DPet’s decision to determine if our dog can use their daycare or not, but the problem is they lack the basic common sense and communication to let us know; we called ahead of time for a reason.  Instead, we were hit with a surprise right before heading out on a day trip, causing us to be late for our plans. Not only do they lack basic common sense, but the front desk lady I dealt with was very rude and rather than being apologetic or trying to find a solution pretty much told me to kick rocks. Just do better!

The staff at the D Pet Hotels Arcadia were fantastic and super attentive and friendly the facility is clean and well taken care of our dog stayed three nights and we had pictures and reports every day can't say  about them I highly recommend them .
Thank you for the 5 stars, Tarianna!

I am always stressed when I drop off/pick up my dog. This was my second time using this boarding facility. The front people are not very friendly and seem to be just going through the mechanics of the job. And communication is poor.This last visit they refused to show me where my dog was staying (for 9 days), and i brought EDIBLE, NO Raw Hide chews that he LOVES and they refused to give him these, however, they apparently gave him cloth squeak toy animals as only one was returned out of 9 provided. Apparently, the edible, non raw hide is a choking hazard, but the cloth stuffed squeak toy is not.To top it off, my bill was almost twice what I had expected as they charged holiday pricing. Not just on the 25th and 1st… every SINGLE day! They send photos, some blurry.. in all photos  his ears were back. And messages are non informative. He seemed good when I picked him up, however, I couldn’t get his water bowl filled quick enough upon return home which is disconcerting.

I cannot recommend D Pet Hotels Arcadia enough! I boarded my high-energy pup here over Christmas break, and while an accidental scratch to his eyelid occurred during playtime, the way the staff handled the situation was world-class.

Because it was a holiday, they didn’t hesitate—they called to inform me of the situation and then rushed him to the emergency vet immediately and stayed by his side the entire time to make sure he was calm and cared for. They kept me updated every step of the way, which gave me such peace of mind during a stressful moment. It’s easy to provide good service when things go perfectly, but you find out how great a place truly is when a challenge arises. Their integrity and genuine love for animals shine through. My dog is healing great and will definitely be back!
My miniature golden doodle (Brynnley) absolutely loves staying here, the staff is absolutely wonderful! So happy we found this place! Always a great experience!!!❤️

Hands down the only place I trust leaving my puppy overnight! For starters, and most importantly in my opinion, they have an overnight staff - unlike other places - who are always keeping an eye out for the dogs in case they’re anxious or unwell. This was especially crucial when during his last stay, my pup was super anxious during a big storm and ended up licking his paw to the point it turned into a wound. He had staff help him throughout the night, bandaged it up, and they alerted me ASAP (if needed they would have also coordinated an emergency vet visit of course). If he was somewhere without an overnight staff it would have been hours before anyone could help him. Every single person who works there is also so genuinely caring, both about the dogs and their owners. They send daily updates with pictures so I always know how my dog is doing, and they’re so patient when I have a million different questions or am sad to be leaving him and need extra time cuddling him in the lobby before I say bye. The facility is also clean, smells well, and maintained well. I could say a million more positive things!!

It’s always hard leaving my dog for any amount of time, but I feel so much better knowing he’s with people who truly care about his well being. Plus, I know he’ll always have fun and come home happy and tired out. :) I’m so glad I found them!!

i’ve never left my pup with anyone other than my roommates so leaving him was so hard for me i cried in the lobby. the girl at the front desk went out of her way to text me that evening saying he was having the best time meeting new friends! they sent pictures of my pup every morning which made me so happy!! they are truly so amazing and i will be bringing him back for overnights and even doggy daycare! this is the best environment for him to meet other dogs and be social since it’s such a clean friendly place for him that i know i can trust!
Only took tour, looks like a great place for furbabies!

This place is so wonderful. I take both my boys here and I know that they are given so much love. I also get a collection of photos everyday. They always look so happy. Love the fact that they also get baths the morning of pick up!

Susan, thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a five star review. We are glad you found our pricing fair and truly appreciate you choosing D Pet Hotels.

Polly is such a lovable, playful girl, and we always enjoy having her with us.We hope to welcome you and Polly back again very soon.

Thank you for your five-star rating! We appreciate your support and are thrilled to hear you had a positive experience. If you ever have any feedback or suggestions, feel free to share. We look forward to serving you again soon!

Love this place and their staff! Our dog has stayed there multiple times and I’ve never been disappointed - neither has my dog! Seems like the people treat my fur-dude like he’s one of their own. They always send pictures and updates so I stay in the loop. Thanks D Pet Hotels Arcadia
Thank you for your five-star rating! We're thrilled to hear that you had a great experience with us. Your support means a lot, and we look forward to serving you again soon.
Excellent care for my boy Rocky, I highly recommend D Pet Hotel
My pup always comes home with a smile!  Loves being pampered at D Pet Hotel!🏨. …

It’s never easy having to leave your pets when you take a trip but Arcadia D Pet Hotel makes it so easy. They love my boys almost as much as I do. I drop them off and never worry. So thankful that Rupert and Fergus have a home away from home.

Love D Pet Hotels! Both Arcadia & Scottsdale, but Arcadia is our primary use. Great service, great staff, friendly, attentive & super loving to the doggies. It is clear they take care of our babies. My Serendipity absolutely loves it here and the staff. She gets super excited while we drive to doggy daycare and always pulls excitedly to get through the doors so she can go play. We even get her grooming done here, and she still loves coming & playing with her doggy friends.

Absolutely amazing and beyond our expectations! Not only was this our first drop-in daycare experience with our 4 year old Akita, but we are visiting Phoenix from out of state. The staff made us feel so at ease during our initial meet and greet, and were genuinely engaged and attentive to our needs and concerns. We dropped Kuma off the following day and he was greeted by the same familiar handler from his meet and greet. Kuma has to be kept separate from other dogs, so the supervision and one-on-one interaction definitely put him at ease. We intend to take him back in a couple days for a final daycare experience before we head home. Our only regret is that we do not have a comparable quality service near our home. We highly recommend this company to locals and out of town visitors.

D Pets Arcadia is hands down the best place for my Apollo! From boarding to daycare, he always has a blast and can’t wait to return to spend time with the other pups and the amazing, attentive staff. What sets D Pets apart is their 24/7 …
As always, my Lucie had a great time with her littles pals, and favorite care-giver family in Arcadia! Thank you for taking such great care of my sweetheart!

We recently relocated to Phx and the home we bought needed a lot of construction. Our problem was what to do with our 2 dogs that have never socialized ?
We took a huge step for us and called the Arcadia D Pet hotel to see if they …

Jesse and his team are friendly, attentive, and professional. We feel very comfortable leaving our precious, geriatric pup here while we are away. They shared the most adorable pictures with us during her stay. Thank you for providing a safe and reliable space for our fur baby!

Great for dogs that aren't friendly with other pups :)

I have a rescue Bulldog that isn't good with other animals. D Pet Hotels …

Our Puppy Wadsworth absolutely loves D Pets Hotels Arcadia.  We were referred by a neighbor.  The minute I pull up Wadsworth knows we have arrived.  He gets very excited.  I can barely carry him in he is wiggling to get out of my arms and …

I really wanted to like them. Staff was friendly, they were able to accommodate a last minute stay. But.. they didn’t follow any feeding instructions of give my dog any food portions I prescribed. My dog hasn’t been eating since she’s …
Our dog loves staying at the D Pet Hotel in Arcadia. They are the best at sending photos and updates of his stay.
